verse.verse_2: who amasses wealth, counting it over,
verse.verse_3: thinking that his wealth will make him live forever.
verse.verse_4: By no means! He shall surely be cast into the crushing torment.
verse.verse_5: Would that you understood what that crushing torment is like.
verse.verse_6: It is a Fire kindled by God.
verse.verse_7: Reaching right into the hearts of men,
verse.verse_8: it closes in on them from every side
